g.text: OTU groups and individual environmental associations
Environment: pearson; square area = |r|; no causal interpretation
12 matched samples; 12 selected OTUs; 48 others excluded; Bray-Curtis vs each single environmental variable.
Mantel: positive one-sided Pearson; 999 shared permutations, seed 363, free (exchangeability unverified); colors/stars use BH q.
Separate BH families: 30 links / 45 pairs; no diagonal test. Zero-total group rows: 1 (Bray = 1 vs nonempty).
